SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_risk = 'critical') AS critical,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_risk = 'high') AS high,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_risk = 'medium') AS medium,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_risk = 'low') AS low,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_risk = 'minimal') AS minimal,
       COUNT(*) AS total
FROM vendors WHERE status IN ('approved','conditional','monitoring','incident','reevaluation');

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS open,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed' AND closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS closed_7d,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND due_date < now()) AS overdue,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND severity = 'critical') AS critical_open,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS new_7d
FROM vendor_findings;

SELECT v.id, v.legal_name, v.current_score, v.current_risk,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendor_findings f WHERE f.vendor_id = v.id AND f.status = 'open') AS open_findings
FROM vendors v
WHERE v.current_risk IN ('critical','high')
ORDER BY v.current_score ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

SELECT u.email FROM users u
JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
WHERE r.code IN ('admin','risk_analyst','auditor') AND u.is_active = true;
